reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her direct message. She needs to keep **Tuesday 10 November, from 16:15** free.

On 14 October she told me in this direct message that her standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Plover rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 16:15. Nothing newer changes that. The call isn't on her calendar for next week, so I suggested she block the time herself or let me add it. I didn't change her calendar or share this with anyone else.
